prompt:
Detailed 16-bit pixel art top-down game world map of a stylized Beijing city, like a classic JRPG overworld map on warm parchment-colored ground. Ring roads drawn as concentric roads, a river, small parks and trees. Eight clearly separated landmark spots with empty clearings around them for UI pins: an electronics mall tower district, a glass corporate tower with a stage, a cluster of office chat-bubble buildings, a hotel ballroom building, a cozy hackerspace with a big star on the roof, a livestream studio building with ring lights, an old red-brick factory art district, a far suburb of identical apartment blocks with a subway line. Warm muted palette (teal, warm grey, navy, cream, orange accents), no purple neon. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
revised_prompt: Generate a detailed 16-bit pixel art top-down game world map of a stylized Beijing city, like a classic JRPG overworld map. Landscape composition, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. Crisp intentionally placed pixel clusters, consistent overhead orthographic view, charming and readable game environment. Warm parchment-colored ground fills the ENTIRE rectangular image edge to edge, fully opaque. Concentric rectangular ring roads with softly rounded corners evoke Beijing's road network; a winding river, small bridges, little parks and trees connect the city. Exactly EIGHT clearly separated landmark areas, distributed with generous space and distinct silhouettes; each has a large empty cream-ground clearing immediately beside it reserved for a future UI pin, but do not draw any pins or UI. Landmarks: 1) electronics mall tower district with small electronic-window motifs but absolutely no signs or writing; 2) tall glass corporate tower with an outdoor stage; 3) cluster of office buildings shaped like chat bubbles, with blank facades and no symbols inside the bubbles; 4) elegant hotel ballroom building; 5) cozy hackerspace with one large simple five-point architectural star on the roof, not a brand logo; 6) livestream studio with clearly visible circular ring lights; 7) old red-brick factory art district with chimneys and courtyards; 8) far suburban neighborhood of identical apartment blocks with a subway line and station. Balance the eight destinations across the map and keep their surroundings clear so future UI pins will fit without obscuring buildings. Warm muted palette of teal, warm grey, navy, cream, and restrained orange accents. Pixel-art roads and rail lines should be coherent and not overwhelm the landmark silhouettes. No purple neon. Absolutely NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LABELS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS anywhere. No legend, no title, no map frame, no UI. The full rectangular canvas must be filled with opaque parchment-colored ground and city artwork: NO transparency, NO cutouts, NO black corners, NO empty black regions, NO floating island, NO vignette. 画面背景完全不透明，纸面底色铺满整个画面，八个地标清晰分离并预留空白放置UI标记，任何位置都不出现文字、字母、数字或商标。
